Name: WS78's Flower Dance Pack for FS
Author: SpeedInternational
Description:
I've always been disappointed that the Farmer doesn't have any outfit to match the NPCs during the Flower Dance event, and with the release of Fashion Sense, I didn't really have any reason not to try and make them myself aha.

[size=4]This pack includes:[/size]
- Two suit variants based around Poltergeister's [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic
[/url]- One suit based on the vanilla game's Flower Dance NPC suit
- One bodice﻿ based on the vanilla game's Flower Dance NPC dress
- A waistcoat, because I wanted it
- Puffy sleeves for the dress
- A belt accessory for the dress, so you can change the colour of the one already on there if you don't like the green
- Two boutonnieres for the suits, one small and one large
- A flower crown

Each item has a recolourable counterpart, so you can customise them all.

[size=4]New Organisation System:[/size][size=2]
[/size]Version 1.1.0 has a new naming convention for each item following a pattern of letters and numbers.
To give an example: 
﻿ABC-1c

- First letter signifies pack. 
[spoiler] [size=4]Packs and their corresponding Letters
[/size]
﻿Flower Dance
﻿ ﻿A

﻿Summer Fun
﻿ ﻿B
[/spoiler]
- Second letter shows sets and what item of each type are made to go together. So if multiple items have B as the second letter, they're made to be used together. Feel free to mix and match!
- Third letter is meant to show gendered type. [A - Fem] [B - Masc] [C - Any/None]. But this doesn't mean you can't use them on anyone!
- Number after the dash is the variation of design in that set. So some items go in a set, but have slight differences in their designs.
- The letter c after the number lets you know the design is colourable, or some element of the clothing is colourable


If anyone has any suggestions on what they might like to see added in this pack, feel free to make suggestions. I can't promise it will happen, but I'd love to give it a go!
This is my first time making something like this, so if there are any issues, feel free to post so I can see about making fixes. I couldn't find anything wrong when I was testing, but it's easy to miss things.

This content pack won't work without PeacefulEnd's [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] 

﻿[size=3]CREDITS
[/size]I just want to say thank you to:

The people on Github who have made that collection of FS tutorials and shown in detail how to make all the technical stuff
Elizabethcd for the skirt converter. Once I finally worked out how to arrange things on the canvas, it was a fantastic help for making trousers.
